content:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to hand off SOC2 Type II + the recent pen-test output and the partner questionnaire to CloudList for their cloud marketplace listing. They asked for: SOC report (redacted PDF), pen-test summary (redacted), completed vendor questionnaire, and presigned S3 artifacts. Who can own collection + upload? Can we set owners and ETA? :calendar:

samir: I can own the pen-test redaction. Two quick Qs: do they require vuln IDs removed or can we map to severity buckets? Also want legal to confirm we can share the pen-test exec summary.

vinh: I’ll take the upload to CloudList portal once artifacts are ready. FYI they usually expect presigned URLs with 7-day expiry. If legal insists on shorter, we can do 72h. I’ll also produce a manifest CSV with checksums.

katie: GTM note — we want the listing to go live the week of Apr 21. So ideal upload + acceptance by Apr 14 to leave time for review. If timelines slip we may need to delay the joint announcement.

samir: For redaction approach: propose we keep sections 1-3 of the pen-test (scope, exec summary, remediation status) public and redact detailed findings (vuln names, PoC). I’ll draft a redaction map and run it by legal.

elaine: That sounds good. Samir — can you have the redacted pen-test + redaction map by EOD Thu? (owner: samir) Vinh — can you prepare the S3 presign flow + manifest template by Fri so we can test? (owner: vinh)

vinh: Yep. Quick draft presign command for testing (aws-cli):

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/partner_x/pen-test-redacted.pdf --expires-in 604800
```

(That uses 7d expiry — I’ll parameterize it.)

marketplace-bot: Reminder: CloudList portal requires artifact filenames to be <= 100 chars and no spaces. Upload attempts failing will trigger a manual review.

katie: Thanks — linking legal: @samir pls ping legal once you have the draft so they can confirm attestation language. Also I’ll tentatively block Apr 14-21 in the roadmap.

elaine: Great — owners agreed: samir (pen-test redaction + map) by 1729200000, vinh (upload flow + presign manifest) by 1729260000, legal to confirm attestation by EOD Thu. I’ll send a calendar invite for a short handoff call tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

vinh: Acked. Will post the manifest template in this thread when ready.

samir: Will share the redaction draft here and tag legal.

elaine: Perfect — thanks team.
